title: Auto-hold and features no longer working
summary: Reviews in this topic describe features or driving behavior that no longer work as expected, with one positive note about the autohold control layout but limited coherence across examples.

positive.summary: Positive feedback notes the autohold function remains accessible even without a single dedicated button.

negative.summary: Negative feedback describes driving dissatisfaction, a feature that no longer works, and windows no longer auto-closing after changes, with a possible fuel-use complaint in the same fragment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined feedback says the BMW guide disappeared after a few months and was no longer available, without enough context to classify the sentiment more precisely.

limitations: This topic mixes several loosely related issues, including autohold controls, driving feel, guide availability, window behavior, and possible fuel consumption changes.
One negative evidence fragment includes an undetermined sub-point about increased fuel use after an update, so the exact complaint bundle is not fully separable from the sample.
The small, stratified sample provides limited context and is not sufficient to judge how common any specific issue is.
